capabilities: Convert the whole note to Slack-compliant Markdown
Convert the current selection to Slack-compliant Markdown
Copy the converted Markdown to the clipboard
extras: README shows before/after examples (Obsidian selection vs. Slack message), but they were images and are not readable as text.
problem: Obsidian Markdown is not fully Slack-compatible, so pasting notes into Slack loses formatting or requires manual fixing.
summary: Converter that copies a note or the current selection to the clipboard as Slack-compliant Markdown.
